summary: Tested Endless Practice Premium gating (backend 403 gate on GET /api/practice and POST /api/practice/complete, Home CTA hiding, slim verify-email banner, practice.tsx 403 fallback screen). All 8 new backend pytest cases pass. Full frontend flows verified via browser automation for both a trial-expired (non-Premium) user and a fresh-signup (Premium/trial) user. Everything works as specified; no bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: Note (informational, not a bug): app/index.tsx already auto-redirects any user with is_pro=false && trial_status==='ended' straight to /paywall on app load, before the (tabs) Home screen ever mounts. So a genuinely non-Premium user only reaches Home (and sees the hidden practice-cta) after explicitly tapping the paywall 'X' close button, or via the tab bar afterward. This is pre-existing routing behavior (not part of this task) but is worth knowing: it means the Home CTA gating change is reachable but only through this secondary path, which I verified explicitly.

Verified compute_pro(): is_pro=False always implies trial_status=='ended' (no other combination), so the 'trial ended' scenario is the only real non-Premium state reachable via normal signup - consistent with the agent-to-agent note; founder override / active subscription are the only other ways to be non-pro=false intentionally, not applicable here.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed test users via signup API for backend pytest (auto-cleaned in teardown fixture). Also created two persistent UI test users for browser automation: test_ui_free_aafe896b@example.com (trial forcibly expired via direct MongoDB update to trial_ends_at/trial_started_at, simulating non-Premium) and test_ui_pro_116fdfc8@example.com (fresh signup, active trial = Premium). These two are NOT auto-cleaned; safe to leave or remove.
context_for_next_testing_agent: practice.tsx and (tabs)/index.tsx gating fully verified both via curl/pytest (backend 403 + localized detail en/de/es) and Playwright (Home CTA hidden/shown, slim verify banner tap->modal, direct /practice deep-link 403 fallback with lock icon/Unlock Premium->/paywall/Back to Learn, full premium quiz flow with XP award).
